documents.description:
SECOND declawed gate on main, and it is a SECURITY one. .github/workflows/security.yml:52 names the job "Sobelow static analysis (regression gate, baseline .sobelow-skips)" and :55 sets continue-on-error: true. Job-level truth over the last 8 non-cancelled main pushes: Sobelow 8/8 FAILURE while every one of those RUNS concluded `success`. The sibling job in the same workflow (Dependency CVE audit / mix_audit, blocking) is 8/8 green — so the workflow is not broken, only this job is, and only invisibly.

Per repo memory the reds are line-shifted baselined findings rather than new vulnerabilities, and the problem has been filed twice and remains unfixed — which is exactly the "teaches readers to dismiss it" pattern this epic exists to remove. Reconcile the .sobelow-skips baseline against current line numbers, make the job green, then remove continue-on-error so it can red for exactly one reason: a NEW finding.

METHOD: rank by JOB-level conclusions, never run-level — run-level shows zero failures for security.yml.

purpose.statement: Reconcile the Sobelow baseline and make static security analysis blocking for genuinely new findings.
purpose.why:
Within the larger goal “Honest Gates security — a successful workflow run must not conceal a failing security job.”, this task has a specific role: Turns a job-level failure hidden by continue-on-error into a green baseline plus a mutation-proven regression gate.

The larger security goal needs developers to investigate a new finding when Sobelow turns red. Instead, line-shifted baseline entries make the job fail on every main run while job-level continue-on-error lets the workflow conclude success; repeated expected red teaches everyone to ignore it. Re-pinning the baseline before removing the escape hatch is the right intervention because blocking the current 8/8 failure state would freeze all merges, while leaving continue-on-error makes a real new vulnerability indistinguishable from baseline drift. If omitted, the security dashboard remains green precisely while its analyzer is red.
